svg.title: Figure 8-2. FTTI scenes: the longitudinal safety goals (WP-C-04 §8)
svg.desc: One card per safety goal, the longitudinal safety goals: SG-03 If an input is lost or wrong, acceleration must stop within 1 s; SG-04 If an input is lost or wrong, hard braking must stop within 1 s; SG-06 If braking is lost, the driver must be warned within 1 s.
svg.text: Figure 8-2. FTTI scenes: the longitudinal safety goals

Each card: the §8 FTTI budget against today; what the safety mechanism must prevent (schematic, loops every 6 s); the timeline from fault to safe state; what it must do and does today; who carries the FSRs and how many are met.
Goals, FSRs, trace, budgets and implementation status from WP-C-04 §3, §5, §8 and §9. The scenes and the times shown for today are schematic, not measurements.

g.title: SG-03: If an input is lost or wrong, acceleration must stop within 1 s
g.text: SG-03 · ASIL C ⚠ · SAFE STATE: ACCEL ≤ 0, ACC CANCELLED
If an input is lost or wrong,
H-03 unintended acceleration · FTTI ≤ 1 s · 13 FSRs serve it
WHAT THE SAFETY MECHANISM MUST PREVENT · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S
An input the envelope gates on is lost
FAULT TO SAFE STATE · NEEDED AGAINST TODAY
WHAT THE SAFETY MECHANISM MUST DO
Detect a lost, corrupt, repeated or stale input
within 0.5 s and bring acceleration to zero within
Detection is as for SG-01. Since opendbc de80b63 the RX checks
revoke within 0.162 s, not yet verified on hardware; the
WHO CARRIES THE 13 FSRs SERVING SG-03 (§9, §5 ALLOC)

g.title: SG-04: If an input is lost or wrong, hard braking must stop within 1 s
g.text: SG-04 · ASIL B ⚠ · SAFE STATE: INACTIVE, BOUNDED JERK
If an input is lost or wrong, hard
H-04 unintended braking · FTTI ≤ 1 s · 14 FSRs serve it
WHAT THE SAFETY MECHANISM MUST PREVENT · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S
A wrong input reads as a lead braking
FAULT TO SAFE STATE · NEEDED AGAINST TODAY
WHAT THE SAFETY MECHANISM MUST DO
Detect a lost or corrupt input within 0.5 s and end
the braking command, with bounded jerk, within the 1
Same detection as SG-03: within 0.162 s in the reference
build, not yet verified on hardware (GAP-06). The envelope has
no jerk limit, so any in-bound step passes.
WHO CARRIES THE 14 FSRs SERVING SG-04 (§9, §5 ALLOC)

g.title: SG-06: If braking is lost, the driver must be warned within 1 s
g.text: SG-06 · ASIL C · SAFE STATE: WARNING, ACC CANCELLED
If braking is lost, the driver must be
H-06 silent loss of braking · FTTI ≤ 1 s · 16 FSRs serve it
FTTI BUDGET (§8) · SG-02, SG-06 (LOSS WITHOUT WARNING)
warns at once, actuates on stale inputs ≈ 3.5 s
WHAT THE SAFETY MECHANISM MUST PREVENT · SCHEMATIC, LOOPS EVERY 6 S
Driver must brake, warned or not
FAULT TO SAFE STATE · NEEDED AGAINST TODAY
WHAT THE SAFETY MECHANISM MUST DO
Detect a loss of longitudinal deceleration within
0.5 s, warn within 1 s and cancel ACC so the driver
As for SG-02: the soft disable warns at once but keeps acting
on stale inputs for up to about 3.5 s (GAP-16).
WHO CARRIES THE 16 FSRs SERVING SG-06 (§9, §5 ALLOC)
